requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation is incomplete. It only provides a basic context manager but doesn't actually implement the necessary logic to detect and hook Flask applications and their routes/handlers.
requirement.contract: The flask hook should detect Flask applications and automatically hook their view functions and error handlers when a Flask application is running, ensuring that HTTP requests to Flask endpoints are properly recorded in the HTTP records.

requirement.description: The generic hook implementation has overly complex and redundant Flask detection logic that is not working correctly to hook Flask routes and error handlers from Flask application modules.
requirement.contract: The generic hook should properly identify Flask applications and their associated view functions and error handlers, and hook them appropriately so that HTTP requests to Flask endpoints are captured and recorded.
